title: The Distant Terminal
author: Gideon Ishikawa
blurb: Elodie Sandoval, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
